name: io.github.ericlovold/sanction
title: Sanction
description: Approval and budget checks before agent spending or tool use. Cooperative MCP; host must ask.

environmentVariables.name: SANCTION_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent API key (pxy_...). Create one at https://getsanction.com or via POST /api/v1/wallets then POST /api/v1/agents.

environmentVariables.name: SANCTION_WALLET_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional override for sanction_wallet_status; by default the wallet derives from the agent key.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Sanction agent key (pxy_...). Store in the host secret configuration, never in chat.
